theorem quadratic_completed_square_bounded_sublevel_radius
    (a c r s : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hs : 0 ≤ s)
    (hf : ∀ x : ℝ, f x = (x - a)^2 + c) :
    a ∈ Set.Icc (a - r) (a + r) ∧
      IsMinOn f (Set.Icc (a - r) (a + r)) a ∧
      ∀ x : ℝ, x ∈ Set.Icc (a - r) (a + r) →
        (f x ≤ c + s^2 ↔ x ∈ Set.Icc (a - s) (a + s)) := by
  have h₁ : a ∈ Set.Icc (a - r) (a + r) := by
    constructor
    · 
      linarith [hr]
    · 
      linarith [hr]
  
  have h₂ : IsMinOn f (Set.Icc (a - r) (a + r)) a := by
    refine' fun x hx => _
    have h₃ : f x = (x - a)^2 + c := hf x
    have h₄ : f a = c := by
      rw [hf]
      ring_nf
      <;> simp [sq]
      <;> ring_nf
    have h₅ : (x - a)^2 ≥ 0 := sq_nonneg (x - a)
    have h₆ : f x ≥ f a := by
      rw [h₃, h₄]
      linarith
    exact h₆
  
  have h₃ : ∀ x : ℝ, x ∈ Set.Icc (a - r) (a + r) → (f x ≤ c + s^2 ↔ x ∈ Set.Icc (a - s) (a + s)) := by
    intro x hx
    constructor
    · 
      intro h₄
      have h₅ : f x = (x - a)^2 + c := hf x
      rw [h₅] at h₄
      have h₆ : (x - a)^2 + c ≤ c + s^2 := h₄
      have h₇ : (x - a)^2 ≤ s^2 := by linarith
      have h₈ : x ∈ Set.Icc (a - r) (a + r) := hx
      have h₉ : a - r ≤ x := h₈.1
      have h₁₀ : x ≤ a + r := h₈.2
      have h₁₁ : a - s ≤ x := by
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x - a), sq_nonneg (x + a), sq_nonneg (x - a + s), sq_nonneg (x - a - s)]
      have h₁₂ : x ≤ a + s := by
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x - a), sq_nonneg (x + a), sq_nonneg (x - a + s), sq_nonneg (x - a - s)]
      exact ⟨h₁₁, h₁₂⟩
    · 
      intro h₄
      have h₅ : f x = (x - a)^2 + c := hf x
      rw [h₅]
      have h₆ : x ∈ Set.Icc (a - s) (a + s) := h₄
      have h₇ : a - s ≤ x := h₆.1
      have h₈ : x ≤ a + s := h₆.2
      have h₉ : (x - a)^2 ≤ s^2 := by
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x - a), sq_nonneg (x + a), sq_nonneg (x - a + s), sq_nonneg (x - a - s)]
      linarith
  
  exact ⟨h₁, h₂, h₃⟩
